citations.quote: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations. Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: missiles or falling objects; fire; theft or larceny; explosion or earthquake; windstorm; hail, water or flood; malicious mischief or vandalism; riot or civil commotion; contact with a bird or animal; or breakage of glass.

output.reasoning: The claim describes a falling object (tree branch) during a windstorm. Under clause [COMP-1], falling objects and windstorms are explicitly defined as 'other than collision' (comprehensive) coverage. The damage to the windshield and hood resulting from this event is covered under this provision.
